items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Penico. The mention of Penico occurs entirely within the [INTERVIEWER]'s turn: 'He had Penico with him.'

ctx.x: I played with him in 1921. 1921 on the boat.

I didn't know that. I didn't know that. He had a big, heavy-shaped guy. I didn't know that. He played a long bass. I played with him in 1921. 1921 on the boat. I didn't know that. I didn't know that. He had Penico with him. He had Penico with him. He actually had Penico break his armband. 23, Penico had his armband out there. When you first did you know that? He played with him. He played with him in 1921. He played with him in 1921. He played with him in 1921. When did you first hear Tesh, Mark?

Oh, I knew Tesh in 1925. When I went to Jimmy McPartland and Bud Freeman. So when I left White City, grew up in Midway Gardens, I got a hold of Tesh and Jess. We really had a swinging band at that Midway. I was considered the best band in Chicago at that time. Midway. Is that so? Oh, yeah. We used to outdraw the Trianon. You know, the big name band. Oh, really? Oh, yeah. Whose band was that? It was just a house band. House band. Right. Was Midway out on the Midway? Out near there? That was in the 60th and the…
